google_api_key.title: Gemini API key
google_api_key.description: Google AI Studio API key for the bundled Gemini MCP server (drafting, editing, synthesis, OCR). Free tier at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Stored securely (OS keychain / protected credentials file), never in plaintext settings.json. Optional — GOOGLE_API_KEY env var or .academic-helper/secrets.json still work if you skip this.
